abuse_act_body: We can suspend an engine: our relays stop routing its address, and it can no longer register or report in. We cannot delete anything from the owner's server. For an engine on a custom domain, also tell the domain's owner or registrar.
abuse_contact_unavailable: The address could not be loaded. Try again later.
abuse_intro: Promptbook engines run on their owners' own servers. Each one is reachable at an address under our engine domain or at a custom domain. If one of them hosts phishing, malware or anything else that harms people, tell us.
abuse_report_item_address: the full address (URL) of the page, including the engine's hostname;
abuse_report_item_evidence: a screenshot, or the message that led you there, if you have one.
abuse_report_item_what: what the page does or asks for, and when you saw it;
abuse_report_response: We confirm every report and act on a confirmed one within hours. Do not send us passwords or other secrets you may have typed into the page.
abuse_security: Security vulnerabilities in Promptbook itself go to the same address. Machine-readable details are in
abuse_see_can: We can see which account an engine belongs to, whether it is online, how much traffic passes through our relays, and the page it shows to anyone who opens it without signing in. We check that public page ourselves, as any visitor would.
abuse_see_cannot: We cannot see what an engine shows to signed-in users or what its traffic contains: the connection is encrypted end to end between the visitor's browser and the owner's server, and our relays only pass it on.
abuse_see_title: What we can and cannot see

{recoveryLink}

trust_promise: Your agents, chats and files stay on your own server. We connect you to them, but we can't read them.
trust_path_browser_body: Seals everything it sends so that only your engine can open it.
trust_path_relay_body: Passes the sealed traffic on to your engine. It can't open it.
trust_path_engine_body: Holds your data and its keys. The connection opens only here.
trust_path_dashboard_body: Off to the side: your account, billing, and your engines' addresses and status. Never what is inside them.
trust_cannot_see_body: Your agents, chats and files live on your engine. We never store them, not even encrypted.
trust_cannot_open_body: It is encrypted all the way from your browser to your engine. Our relays only pass it on and hold none of its keys.
trust_cannot_change_body: The app you use is signed, publicly logged and the same for everyone. Your engine checks it before serving it, and installs updates on its own only once they have been public for at least a day.
trust_cannot_admit_body: Everyone signs in with a passkey made for your engine. Only your engine can add people or make someone its owner; your Promptbook account grants nothing inside it.
trust_cannot_card_body: You pay on Stripe's own pages, so your card details go straight to Stripe and never reach Promptbook.
trust_can_status_title: See that your engine is well
trust_can_status_body: Every minute your engine tells us whether it is online, its version, how busy it is and how many agents and members it has. Never names or text.
trust_can_stop_body: We can cut the connection, and remove people who joined through this dashboard unless your engine's owner turns that off. Even then, or if we are ever down, your agents keep running and nothing is lost.
trust_check_security: Your engine's Security page shows the app's signature and public log entry, and exactly what your engine last sent us.
trust_check_fingerprint: Each engine has a fingerprint, a small pattern and code that looks the same here and on the engine. If they differ, enter nothing there and open your engine from this dashboard.
trust_check_certificates: Your engine also checks the public certificate logs every hour and warns you if anyone else gets a certificate for its address.

Your setup is saved, so you can finish it later.
